risks.risk: Whether a separate center table is included (photo may only show the TV console).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full center table (top, legs, and any matching set) and confirm it is included in the same pickup.
risks.if_unproven: Price the item as TV console only (center table not included).

risks.risk: TV details (size, brand/model) are not readable; could be a low-end or different size than expected.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the TV brand/model label (back sticker) and the screen size measurement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/unspecified TV console setup with the TV treated as not verifiable (worst-case: basic/older TV).

risks.risk: Functionality: TV may not work (screen is off/black in the photo; no power-on proof).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video powering on the TV and showing a channel/menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (or untested) until power-on is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Damage/defects not visible in this single angle (scratches, cracks, missing parts, loose hinges/shelves).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of edges/corners, shelf joints, and the glass/transparent panel for chips or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible minor wear (no assumption of perfect condition).

risks.risk: Mounting/installation hardware may be missing (if it’s wall-mounted).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the back mounting points and any included brackets/bolts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console without guaranteed mounting hardware.

proof_requests: Photo(s) of the center table clearly showing it is included (if it exists).
Close-up of the TV back label (brand/model) and screen size measurement.
Short video showing the TV turning on and displaying a menu/channel.
Close-ups of corners/edges, shelf joints, and the glass/transparent panel for cracks/chips.
Photos of mounting/back hardware (brackets/bolts) if it’s wall-mounted.
response.reason: From the photo, I can only confidently see a TV console with an off/black TV screen; the separate center table and TV specs/functionality are not verifiable remotely, so a safe worst-case price can’t be set yet.
